'''Star Tours Flight 104''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Carosi XII]] and [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] just before a [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138|raid]] at the Star Tours space station. It was stationed at Gate 2A, and landed at 0720 hours, and its estimated time of departure was 0815.
